he.text: Prayers are said as on other week days, adding עֲנֵנוּ after אַל תְּשִׁיבֵנוּ in שְׁמַע קוֹלֵנוּ in the Ameedah. In the repetition of the Ameedah by the Reader, the following סְלִיחוֹת (Propitiatory Prayers) are added in the order described, commencing at כִּי פָשָׁעְנוּ in סְלַח לָנוּ.

en.text: Prayers are said as on other week days, adding in the Ameedah the prayer “Answer us,” page 51. In the repetition of the Ameedah by the Reader, the following Propitiatory Prayers are added in the order described, commencing “we have transgressed,” page 48.

editorial_expansion: Retain the Amidah performance rubric: the book does not supply a whole Amidah here. The commencement citation names the earlier confession ending; read the full later service before determining whether a bounded transclusion is needed. English Second Fast means Hebrew Monday (לשני), the first of the Monday–Thursday–Monday series, not the second penitential day.
